g.text: DURESS / From delivery pressure to business-state proof
One Python application. A model proposes; deterministic execution establishes findings.
HOSTED BOUNDARY: trusted synthetic targets only · token-protected writes · quotas · single worker
VERIFIED means bounded evidence for a reproducer. Hosted storage is ephemeral; export your proof.
